name: Frequency code
description: Code specifying the rate of recurrence.

values.name: Annually (calendar year)
values.description: Annually (calendar year) Code defining a yearly forecast.

values.name: Continuous
values.description: Continuous Flexible frequency scheduling based on continuous consumption of items.

values.name: Synchronous
values.description: Synchronous Flexible frequency scheduling based on synchronous consumption of items.

values.name: Discrete
values.description: Discrete Flexible frequency according to planning process.

values.name: Replenishment
values.description: Replenishment Flexible frequency scheduling based on replenishment of the consumption of items.

values.name: Flexible interval (from date X through date Y)
values.description: Flexible interval (from date X through date Y) Code defining a forecasted usage that is planned between two defined dates.

values.name: Just-in-time
values.description: Just-in-time Scheduling based on just-in-time of the need.

values.name: Monthly (calendar months)
values.description: Monthly (calendar months) Code defining a forecast by calendar month(s).

values.name: Quarterly (calendar quarters)
values.description: Quarterly (calendar quarters) Code defining a forecast by calendar quarter(s). (Jan- Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec).

values.name: Semi-annually (calendar year)
values.description: Semi-annually (calendar year) Code defining a forecast for the first six months of the year or the second six months of the year.

values.name: Four week period (13 periods per year)
values.description: Four week period (13 periods per year) Code defining a forecast for four week intervals.

values.name: Weekly
values.description: Weekly Code defining a forecast for weekly intervals.

values.name: Daily
values.description: Daily Code defining a schedule by day.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Mutually defined Code reserved for special trading partner requirements when pre-defined codes do not exist.
